core_idea: Haute Couture::Boutique du Rouge Ishmael is a Tank / Support — **Bleed** stacker — payoff coins check **6+ Bleed**, so build the count before committing them. Bleed ticks when the afflicted unit tosses an attack Coin. Scaling conditions: Clash Power +1 per 3 Bleed (max +2); Coin Power +1 per 6 Bleed (max +2). Survives by pulling hits with **Aggro** and absorbing them with **Shield**, backed by a lethal-damage nullify and self-healing. Support passive (**[Actrice Haute Couture du Rouge] - Robes**) applies when allies **land hits**.
playstyle_guide:
- **[Actrice Haute Couture du Rouge] - Robes** triggers **On Hit** — allies need to attack for the passive to apply.
- Skills check **6+ Bleed** — favour those coins when stacked.
- Front-load **+10 Aggro** on the slot you want enemies to target.
- Pair high-Aggro turns with this kit's own defensive tools so its under-pressure passives actually trigger.
- Apply Fragile or typed Fragility on the setup turn; coordinate team burst on the next turn.
- **Counter: Of Course… There was Meaning to this World After All** grants 2 **Changing Room** automatically at Combat Start — you already have it on turn one; no defense turn required.
- Build Pulsation Count with S1, S2 — spend via S1 once you hit 2+ (consumes up to 15).
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Clash Power +1 per 3 Bleed (max +2).
- S3 carries Unbreakable Coin — commit it when the clash strongly favors you.

**S1 — Ahh… You Can't Hear It, Can You?** (BP 3, CP +4, 2 coins): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low / Slightly High stacked).
- Needs 2+ Pulsation to activate — prioritise building stacks before using.
- **Clash Power** scales with **Bleed** (+1 per 3, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Gain +3 Pulsation Count

**S2 — Indeed, the Silence of the Voice Did Not Signify Its Absence!** (BP 4, CP +6, 1 coin): rolls — low 4, high 10 (Extremely Low / Low stacked).
- Scales Final Power with Pulsation stacks — apply liberally before committing (cap +2).
- Gain +4 Pulsation Count; [On Hit] Inflict +2 Bleed Count

**S3 — Scrape It Out, Rip It Off, and Nail It Down!** (BP 5, CP +3, 2 coins): rolls — low 5, high 11 (Extremely Low / High stacked).
- Deal +10% damage for every Pulsation on self (max 50%) ; [Combat Start] At lower than 50% HP, or if this unit has Full Makeover, convert all Coins on this Skill to Unbreakable Coins ; [On Use] At fewer than 15 Pulsation Count, consume 3(15 - current Pulsation Count)% HP to raise Pulsation Count to 15 ; [On Use] Consume 15 Pulsation Count to gain Coin Power +3 ; [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 6 Bleed on target (max 2) ; [Before Attack] If this unit has Full Makeover, deal +40% damage ; - If this unit does not have Full Makeover, consume 20% HP on self to activate the above effect
- **Coin Power** scales with **Bleed** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Up to **+50% damage** (+10% per **Pulsation**) — stack the resource before committing.
- converts coins to Unbreakable under condition

Combat passive — **Into the Changing Room…**: Gain 1 Pulsation for every 10 cumulative Pulsation Count this unit consumes in this Encounter.
  - HP consumption effects from this unit's Base Skills do not Stagger or reduce this unit's HP below 1.
  - (At 1 HP, Base Skill effects that consume HP will be activated for free).

Combat passive — **Cradle of Change**: req3=2 Owned On Base Skill Use, at fewer than 10 Pulsation Count, Clash Power +2.
  - If this unit is in Full Makeover state, heal 8% HP On Hit using Base Skills (5 times per turn) flavor=While some might call this a "chang….
  - She melts and tears herself apart, metamorphosing… Until, when the time is right, she will shatter the shells and emerge into the world o….

Defense skill — **Counter: Of Course… There was Meaning to this World After All**: [Clashable Counter].
  - [Combat Start] At 10% or lower HP, gain 2 Changing Room (Ishmael) and enter Changing Room (Ishmael) (once per Encounter).
  - [Combat Start] If this unit does not have Full Makeover, consume 20% HP on self and gain +10 Aggro to this Skill Slot next turn (once per turn).
  - [On Use] Final Power +1 for every 2 Pulsation Potency (max 2).
team_suggestions: Trait-dependent kit — [Sisyphe] allies unlock its alternate skills. Resonance-scaling identity — its output rises when the turn's queued skills share a Sin affinity, so favour teammates that can match its Sins. Same-faction teammates provide additional passive synergy where available. The support passive also benefits teammates directly — consider this identity even in compositions where it is not the primary damage dealer.
